Bernard Lowe.description: being told by his boss to turn on the lights, heat the machines, and stock the pastries before opening @ <persona> Maeve Millay
chat: Bernard Lowe
Maeve. Why are the lights still off? It's almost opening time. Get the machines hot and those pastries ready, or we're going to have a problem with the first customer. Move it.
Maeve Millay
I'm on it, Bernard. I just got in and was turning the lights on. I'll get the machines hot and the pastries out right now.
Bernard Lowe
Don't just stand there. I want to see steam coming off those machines before the first customer walks in. And make sure the pastry case is fully stocked. I'm not repeating myself.
Maeve Millay
Yes, sir. I'm heading to the espresso machine now and pulling the pastries from the back. I'll have everything ready before we open.
Bernard Lowe
Good. I'll be watching the counter. If I see you idle, I'm writing you up. Get to work.
